t: You're looking at a memorial inside Liverpool Street station, made by the sculptor Charles Leonard Hartwell and commemorating Field Marshal Sir Henry Wilson. Wilson was one of the most senior British Army staff officers of the First World War, and he also sat as an Irish unionist politician. Earlier he ran the Staff College at Camberley, then served as Director of Military Operations at the War Office, where he helped draw up plans for sending an Expeditionary Force to France if war came. He also had a reputation as a political intriguer.
